audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer labels the lane 'HARD' while diffRating is 4/10 and the TL;DR says 'Crush her early'. Those cannot all be true.
audit.why: Emerald+ 51.85% over 54 games with melee-form Kayle as the early loser: the lane is favoured early and hard late, not flatly HARD.
audit.corrected: Keep diffRating 4/10 and reframe 'diff' as a lane that inverts at her ranged/2-item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content level chart gives Levels 2 and 3 to Kayle, but whys[1] and whys[2] on the same page say melee Kayle cannot trade back through Spirit Abjuration.
audit.why: Kayle has no dash and is melee at those levels; Twofold Hex (900) out-ranges everything she has except Radiant Blast.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 should read Aurora, matching the prose already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Radiant Blast reducing resistances is never mentioned, Divine Judgment's 160s rank-1 cooldown is never given, and Celestial Blessing's heal is never tied to Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q 'reducing the resistances of all hit'; R cooldown 160/120/80; W heals her and the nearest ally.
audit.corrected: Her Q shreds your MR before Starfire Spellblade (an auto reset) lands, so the resist-shred window is the burst. Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 — bait it and you own the next two and a half minutes. Buy anti-heal against Celestial Blessing (15s flat).

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block carries no numbers at all.
audit.why: Divine Judgment 160s at rank 1 is the single largest punish window in the matchup and is not stated.
audit.corrected: Divine Judgment 160/120/80; Radiant Blast 12s at rank 1; Celestial Blessing 15s flat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly claims Aurora becomes 'untargetable' via Across the Veil and Between Worlds. Riot's text says Across the Veil makes her INVISIBLE; Between Worlds grants no untargetability at all.
audit.why: Across the Veil: 'entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible'. Between Worlds only damages, slows, and lets her teleport across the zone.
audit.corrected: Say she vanishes (invisibility) on the W leap, and that Between Worlds lets her cross the zone — never 'untargetable'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kayle is referred to as 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, breakdown.mid and dontsFull[0].d.
audit.why: Template pronoun leakage; breaks the second-person coaching voice.
